name: Scheduled report as a PDF, sent by email (pdfrender)

parameters.content:
## Scheduled report as a PDF, sent by email

Every morning at 7:00 the workflow fetches records from an API, builds one color-coded HTML report (expired, due within 7 days, due within 30 days), renders it to a PDF with pdfrender and emails it.

**Try it**: the fetch step has pinned sample records, so **Execute workflow** runs end to end before you point it at your API.

API key: https://pdfrender.dev/go/tpl-scheduled-report-pdf-email?to=/app/api-keys

### Setup

1. **Every day at 7:00**: change the time, or switch the interval to weeks or months for a client report.
2. **Fetch records**: set the URL (and auth) of the API that returns your records as a JSON array. Any n8n node that outputs items works here: a database query, Google Sheets, Airtable.
3. **Build report HTML**: rename the keys, change the thresholds and the layout.
4. **pdfrender node**: on self-hosted n8n, open **Settings > Community Nodes**, install `@pdfrender-dev/n8n-nodes-pdfrender`, then add a **pdfrender API** credential with your API key. On n8n Cloud, which installs only verified community nodes, replace this node with an HTTP Request node: `POST https://api.pdfrender.dev/v1/render`, header `X-API-Key`, a JSON body with the fields `html` and `filename` (Using Fields Below) and Response Format **File**. The README has the details.
5. **Email the PDF**: add a Gmail credential and set the recipients.
